guide.page.title: Hugo Panel — Installation and usage guide
guide.page.description: Complete installation and usage guide for Hugo Panel: Linux / macOS single-binary install, Docker deployment, first run, content and theme management, builds, deployment, environment variables and FAQ.
guide.title: Installation and usage guide
guide.lead: From download to your first publish: how to install, configure, use and maintain Hugo Panel.
guide.req.title: Requirements
guide.req.lead: Hugo Panel runs as a single executable. The frontend assets and SQLite are built in.
guide.req.os.body: Linux (amd64 / arm64) or macOS (Intel / Apple Silicon)
guide.req.hugo.body: Hugo Extended 0.120 or newer, available on PATH
guide.req.port.body: Defaults to 55530; change it with PORT or ADDR
guide.req.disk.body: About 100 MB for the binary, SQLite and caches; Hugo site content is additional
guide.req.docker: Docker deployments do not need Hugo on the host. The image includes Hugo Extended, rsync and openssh-client.
guide.install.title: One-command install (Linux / macOS)
guide.install.lead: The installer detects your OS and architecture, downloads the matching release and verifies its SHA-256 checksum. It installs to ~/.local/bin by default, or /usr/local/bin when run as root.
guide.install.hint: Optional environment variables: HP_VERSION=v0.0.6 pins a release, HP_INSTALL_DIR=/path changes the install directory. Run hugo-panel --version to verify the install.
guide.install.manual.title: Manual download
guide.install.manual.lead: You can also download the matching archive from the Releases page, extract it and put hugo-panel on your PATH.

guide.docker.title: Docker install
guide.docker.lead: The Docker image includes Hugo Extended, rsync and openssh-client. It is a good fit for servers and supports linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

guide.docker.note: The container runs as UID/GID 1000 by default and adjusts mounted directory permissions at startup. If another tool manages permissions, set CHOWN_DATA=false and CHOWN_HUGO=false.
guide.first.title: First run
guide.first.lead: After starting, open http://localhost:55530 and complete the setup wizard.
guide.first.step1.title: Create the administrator
guide.first.step1.body: The first visit opens a wizard where you set the administrator username and password. Passwords are stored with bcrypt.
guide.first.step2.title: Configure the Hugo site directory
guide.first.step2.body: In Settings → General, enter the Hugo site root, the directory that contains hugo.toml or config.toml.
guide.first.step3.title: Confirm the Hugo executable
guide.first.step3.body: The panel uses hugo from PATH by default. You can also enter the absolute path to the Hugo binary.
guide.first.step4.title: Set PUBLIC_URL
guide.first.step4.body: If you access the panel through a domain or reverse proxy, enter the full external URL. It is used for password-reset links and absolute URLs.
guide.first.data: Data is stored in ./data by default (/app/hugo-panel/data in Docker), including the SQLite database, backups, custom translations and caches. Back up this directory regularly.
guide.usage.title: Daily use
guide.usage.lead: Everything happens inside the panel. You do not need to edit configuration files directly.
guide.usage.content.title: Content
guide.usage.content.body: Create, edit, rename, search and delete Markdown pages or posts. YAML / TOML / JSON front matter, drafts, scheduled publishing, tags, categories and live preview are supported.
guide.usage.theme.title: Themes and modules
guide.usage.theme.body: Enable local themes under themes/, or install, update and remove themes from Git. Install plugins as Hugo Modules and run hugo mod tidy.
guide.usage.media.title: Media library
guide.usage.media.body: Browse local directories, S3-compatible storage and WebDAV. Upload, preview, move and copy files, and copy URLs or Markdown links in one click.
guide.usage.build.title: Builds
guide.usage.build.body: Run hugo --gc --minify --cleanDestinationDir and keep the latest output. Send an email notification when a build fails.
guide.usage.deploy.title: Automatic deployment
guide.usage.deploy.body: After a successful build, sync to a remote server over rsync and SSH. Custom ports, private keys, known_hosts verification and --delete are supported.
guide.usage.ai.title: Translation and AI
guide.usage.ai.body: Connect LibreTranslate, DeepL or an OpenAI-compatible service in Settings for title translation, polishing, continuation and summaries. Keys stay on the server.
guide.settings.title: Settings and security
guide.settings.lead: Settings covers General, Deployment, Email, Translation, AI, Languages and Account. SMTP, translation, AI and SSH private keys are stored only on the server.
guide.settings.env.title: Common environment variables
guide.settings.env.data: Data directory for SQLite, backups and caches
guide.settings.env.public: External panel URL for password resets and absolute links
guide.settings.env.cookie: Keep auto when running behind HTTPS
guide.settings.env.latest: Sidebar update-check URL; leave empty to disable
guide.settings.https.title: HTTPS and reverse proxy
guide.settings.https: PWA installation and service workers require HTTPS outside localhost. Terminate TLS with Caddy, Nginx or Traefik, proxy requests to 127.0.0.1:55530, and set PUBLIC_URL=https://your-domain.
guide.settings.security: Do not expose the panel directly to the public internet without HTTPS. Use a strong password after setup and back up the data directory regularly.
guide.ops.title: Upgrade, backup and uninstall
guide.ops.upgrade.title: Upgrade
guide.ops.upgrade.body: Single binary: rerun the installer to replace the binary. Docker: pull the new image and recreate the container. Back up the data directory first.
guide.ops.backup.title: Backup
guide.ops.backup.body: Backing up the data directory preserves settings, users, media indexes and custom translations. Keep the Hugo site itself in Git.
guide.ops.uninstall.title: Uninstall
guide.ops.uninstall.body: Delete the installed executable, or remove the container and image for Docker. The data directory is never deleted automatically; remove it manually after confirming.
guide.faq.title: FAQ
guide.faq.q1: Port 55530 is already in use. What now?
guide.faq.a1: Set PORT to another port and restart. Docker users must also update the host port mapping and PUBLIC_URL.
guide.faq.q2: The panel says Hugo cannot be found.
guide.faq.a2: Make sure hugo version works, or enter the absolute path to the Hugo binary in Settings → General. The Docker image includes Hugo.
guide.faq.a3: After configuring SMTP, use the password-reset link on the login page. If email is unavailable, back up the data and delete data/hugo-panel.db to start over; this loses existing data.
guide.faq.q4: How do I serve the panel over HTTPS?
guide.faq.a4: Terminate TLS at a reverse proxy, forward requests to 127.0.0.1:55530, and set PUBLIC_URL=https://your-domain.
guide.faq.q5: Does an update-check failure affect the panel?
guide.faq.a5: No. The sidebar only reads the GitHub Releases page and fails silently on restricted networks. Set PANEL_LATEST_URL or leave it empty to disable the check.
guide.help.title: Need help?
guide.help.body: Report problems in GitHub Issues, or read the README and example configuration in the repository.
